headlines.title: Classrooms face tech nightmare as Google holds basic search hostage over AI backlash
headlines.summary: Students using Google software in schools will not be allowed to use Google search unless their school system also provides them access to artificial intelligence tools

headlines.title: Nvidia Took Back the World’s Biggest Company Title From Apple on Election Day
headlines.summary: Surging AI demand lifted one tech giant back to the top of the market cap rankings on Election Day, while the same force quietly eroded the margins of its closest rival. The gap between first and second place may not last long.

headlines.title: Is Google's New Cryptocurrency Service a Reason to Buy Ethereum or Solana?
headlines.summary: The company's new platform plays to institutional cybersecurity concerns.

headlines.title: Apple’s ‘Free-Rider’ Status Isn’t Changing Anytime Soon
headlines.summary: Apple just posted a revenue record without building a single hyperscale data center, while Alphabet borrowed billions to fund its AI expansion. The gap between their strategies reveals which company actually holds the leverage in this AI race.

headlines.title: Ray Dalio says one AI risk is hiding in plain sight
headlines.summary: Dalio says one crowded trade now matters more than whether AI is actually in a bubble.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
